sloka: गृह्य शाखाः प्रशाखाश्च स्कन्धांश्चोत्तमशाखिनाम् ।दृष्ट्वा विपरिधावन्तं भवेयुर्भयशङ्किताः ।। ५.३०.२४।।।।
transliteration: gṛhya śākhāḥ praśākhāśca skandhāṁścottamaśākhinām ।dṛṣṭvā viparidhāvantaṁ bhaveyurbhayaśaṅkitāḥ ।। 5.30.24।।।।

translations.english: "Seeing me holding big and small branches of large trees and leaping from one place to the other, the ogresses will get scared.
